person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third person. The diagnostic Goodreads scene about Christopher Keller agrees with the authorized multi-chapter excerpt, which externally narrates both Julian Isherwood and Gabriel Allon and enters their thoughts. First- and second-person forms in the quote set are dialogue or local anecdote, not autonomous narrative sections. No evidence of a first-person frame, sustained second-person narration, or alternating-person structure was found; the main limitation is that the authorized excerpt covers the opening rather than the entire novel.
